answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a non-transferable bond that only vests after several independent peers confirm a unique, hash-linked work trail no other name can reuse. Replica identities fail on that tundra of ongoing cost: each mask needs its own bond and its own trail, so a farm's expense grows linearly with names. Reviewers then split the claim through a prism of uncorrelated checks—prior counterparties, measured latency, and the work receipt—so a puppet farm cannot share one proof. The accepted signal is the intersection of those facets, never a self-issued badge.
